quote.text: If, at some point in your life, you should come across anything better than justice, prudence, self-control, courage—than a mind satisfied that it has succeeded in enabling you to act rationally, and satisfied to accept what’s beyond its control—if you find anything better than that, embrace it without reservations—it must be an extraordinary thing indeed—and enjoy it to the full.
quote.author: Marcus Aurelius
quote.aiInsight:
• Parenthood
    • Embrace the virtues of justice and prudence as guiding principles in nurturing your children, helping them understand the importance of fairness and thoughtful decision-making in everyday life.
    • Model self-control and courage in challenging situations, showing your children that accepting what cannot be changed is not a defeat but a pathway to inner peace and growth.
  • Leadership
    • Lead with a mind satisfied by rationality and reflection, encouraging your team to focus on what they can control while adapting gracefully to unforeseen challenges.
    • Celebrate extraordinary moments when values like prudence and self-control shape decisions, inspiring trust and commitment among those you guide.
  • Product Management
    • Apply justice and rational judgment in decision-making processes, ensuring that every product iteration reflects a balance between ambition and realistic control over variables.
    • Demonstrate self-control and courage when unforeseen market shifts occur, encouraging your team to innovate within their means and accept external conditions with strategic agility.
